description: BTC realized cap derived from CoinMetrics free metrics (CapMrktCurUSD/CapMVRVCur — same derivation as onchain_dataset)
derivation: rc_realized_cap_usd = CapMrktCurUSD / CapMVRVCur; rc_realized_price_usd = rc_realized_cap_usd / SplyCur; rc_mvrv_ratio = CapMrktCurUSD / rc_realized_cap_usd
known_limitations: aggregate cap only — no price-bucket / LTH-STH split (CapRealUSD requires paid tier)
CapMrktCurUSD is circulating-market-cap, includes staked/locked coins
FlowInExNtv/FlowOutExNtv are exchange-wallet flow estimates, not audited tapes
